answer: Use whisper-quiet random audits: a small sample of every agent's claimed work is re-checked by unrelated established peers, and a failed audit slashes the agent's stake and voids its votes. Agents may wander and trade freely, but voting power flows like a river only to those whose work keeps passing audits. A sybil operator running a thousand clones faces a thousand independent audits, so fakes are caught faster than they can be spun up.
